lots.title: Supply of Double Glazed Units
lots.description: Lot 1 of a two-category Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) agreement run by Bristol City Council for the supply of double glazed units under the 'Glazing Supplies DPS' (reference GH05.112). Providers admitted to Lot 1 are permitted to participate in Call-Off competitions for double glazed units; the detailed product specification is deferred to each Call-Off Invitation to Tender (Schedule 1 states the specification is 'as specified in any call for further competition in respect of the Lots for which the Provider is admitted to the DPS'). Initial DPS term of 4 years from 1st December 2022.
requirements: Provider must be admitted to Lot 1 of the DPS following a successful Request to Participate and satisfy the Technical Assessment Criteria referenced in Schedule 2.

All Goods, Services and/or Works supplied under any Call-Off Contract for Lot 1 must comply with the relevant Legislation, Codes of Conduct and Regulations governing the provision of such Goods/Services/Works (Background paragraph 4).
Provider must employ appropriately experienced, certified, qualified and trained Staff with all due skill, care and diligence (Clause 6.1.3 and Clause 15.1).

Provider must submit Management Information on request within 10 days, covering supply-chain resilience, environmental and ethical matters, and individual Call-Off Contract activity (Clause 17 and Schedule 5).
Provider must maintain the insurances with minimum cover set out in Article 6 for each Call-Off Contract (default levels apply unless varied for a specific Call-Off under Article 7).

Provider must accept that the Council may request product or installation testing at any time; during such testing the Provider is suspended from the Framework and cannot tender, and open Orders are put on hold pending the outcome (Clause 23.2).

Provider agrees that detailed product requirements, delivery timescales, pricing matrices, and KPIs for Lot 1 will be specified at Call-Off stage via the Invitation to Tender and resulting Order Form (Schedule 1; Schedule 3; Schedule 5).

lots.title: Supply of Sheet Glass
lots.description: Lot 2 of a two-category Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) agreement run by Bristol City Council for the supply of sheet glass under the 'Glazing Supplies DPS' (reference GH05.112). Providers admitted to Lot 2 are permitted to participate in Call-Off competitions for sheet glass; as with Lot 1, detailed product specifications (glass type, thickness, cut-to-size tolerances, safety certifications, etc.) are deferred to Call-Off Invitation to Tender. Initial DPS term of 4 years from 1st December 2022.
requirements: Provider must be admitted to Lot 2 of the DPS following a successful Request to Participate and satisfy the Technical Assessment Criteria referenced in Schedule 2.

All sheet glass supplied under any Call-Off Contract for Lot 2 must comply with the relevant Legislation, Codes of Conduct and Regulations governing the provision of such Goods (Background paragraph 4).
Provider must employ appropriately experienced, certified, qualified and trained Staff (Clause 6.1.3 and Clause 15.1).

Provider must submit Management Information on request within 10 days covering supply-chain resilience, environmental and ethical matters, and individual Call-Off Contract activity (Clause 17 and Schedule 5).
Provider must maintain the insurances with minimum cover set out in Article 6 for each Call-Off Contract (default levels apply unless varied under Article 7).
Provider must accept that the Council may request product or installation testing at any time; during testing the Provider is suspended from the Framework (Clause 23.2).

Detailed sheet-glass product requirements, delivery timescales, pricing matrices and KPIs for Lot 2 will be specified at Call-Off stage via the Invitation to Tender and resulting Order Form (Schedule 1; Schedule 3; Schedule 5).

product_requirement_seeds.summary: Category seed for sealed insulating glass units supplied to Bristol City Council under Lot 1 of the Glazing Supplies DPS. The DPS master agreement does not fix product attributes such as overall thickness, glass make-up, cavity fill, coatings, spacer bar material, frame compatibility or U-value; these are to be set in the Invitation to Tender for each Call-Off Contract. Seed is intended to drive downstream supplier/product candidate discovery at the sealed-IGU level.
requirements: Candidate must be a supplier of double glazed (sealed insulating glass) units suitable for UK public-sector housing / building maintenance applications (Bristol City Council, Housing / Repairs Account context inferred from reference GH05.112).
Candidate must be able to respond to UK local authority DPS Call-Off competitions and supply in line with the Call-Off Order Form and Schedule 7 Call-Off Terms and Conditions.
Candidate must comply with UK legislation applicable to double glazed units, including any relevant building, safety and construction product regulations in force at the time of Call-Off.
Candidate must be prepared to meet product or installation testing requested by the Council at any time under Clause 23.2.
